description: One real ElevenLabs Agents conversation fetched with the conversations API, scrubbed. Both sides are synthetic speech. Consumers: the WS3 import by conversation ID and the `start_only` transcript rule.

provenance.conversation: POST /v1/convai/agents/create (a dedicated test agent), GET /v1/convai/conversation/get-signed-url, then one session on wss://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/conversation: user_audio_chunk = base64 pcm_16000 at real-time pace in 100 ms chunks; pong on every ping; the client closed the socket (code 1000) after the agent's last reply.

agent_config.first_message: Hello, thanks for calling the restaurant. How can I help?
agent_config.prompt: You are a restaurant booking line used for an automated test. Reply in one short sentence of at most twelve words. Never ask for names, phone numbers or emails.

caller.source: Cartesia TTS lines from the WS0b cache .earshot/pipecat_otlp/caller.wav
script: Hi, I would like to book a table for two people tomorrow evening.
Seven thirty works for us. Could we sit somewhere quiet near the window?
Perfect, that is everything I needed. Thank you very much, goodbye.

scrub_rules: agent_id, conversation_id, branch_id, version_id, user_id and system__*_id dynamic variables, plus any agent_/conv_/agtbrch_/agtvrsn_/user_ ID found by shape: same prefix and length, body = zeros + first-seen counter
voice_id (turn metrics, charging.tts_usage, OTel elevenlabs.voice_id): `voice` + zeros + counter, same length
replacement is applied to the whole text, so IDs inside URIs, OTel attributes and system__conversation_history are covered
kept verbatim: timestamps, durations, costs, metrics, model names and all text. All text is synthetic: the caller script above and the agent's LLM replies
the build refuses to write on any provider_capture.find_leaks rule, env secret (value, phone variants, sha256 prefix) or raw identifier in the output bytes

privacy.t4b_note: All keys are kept, not only the ones a translator reads: the content is synthetic and every identifier is pseudonymised. Owner to confirm.
privacy.agent_name: kept: `earshot-ws0-capture` was chosen by the capture script

field_table.meaning: provider call ID; the session key (`earshot.session.id`)
user side present in the audio
agent side present in the audio
turn text; an interrupted agent turn reads `...`
turn START, whole seconds from start_time
agent turn cut off by the user
`audio` on user turns, null on agent turns
call start, epoch seconds; t=0 of every turn
provider cost in credits = charging.llm_charge + call_charge
provider cost as a fiat amount (unit not stated; USD tier)
null for a websocket call; telephony details otherwise

timing.turn_end: absent; the API gives no end time
timing.otel_variant: recv spans start at time_in_call_secs; each end is the next span's start (the root's end for the last). The interrupted agent turn lasts 10 ms. Ends are derived, not measured.
timing.observed: user turns are floor(speech onset) in all 4 cases (5.15->5, 12.8->12, 14.55->14, 21.55->21); agent turns start at or up to 1.05 s before the audible onset (16 vs 17.05). Audio t=0 = start_time [inferred: turn 0 at 0 is audible from 0.25 s].

audio.container: MPEG audio elementary stream with an ID3v2.4 tag
audio.mpeg: MPEG-2 Layer III, constant bitrate, no Xing/Info frame
audio.channel_layout: mixed: agent and caller in one mono channel
